description: §5.2 rule 3 (S457): a URL attribute whose scheme comes from data is judged at runtime on every write — a non-admitted scheme writes about:blank; relative URLs, safe schemes and a raster data:image on an image source are written unchanged; a literal relative prefix is not re-judged.
rationale: §5.2 rule 3: every covered write "whose value the compiler cannot prove safe" — a quoted value whose literal prefix commits to no scheme, and every non-literal value, in every position incl. <each> rows, judged "on every reactive re-write". Admitted: no scheme, http/https/ftp/mailto/tel/sms, and a raster data:image only on an image-source attribute; "Any other value SHALL be written as `about:blank`". A literal relative prefix is admitted by rule 2 and "is not re-judged".
